'''Kor Vella''' was a popular [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Welcome to Kor Vella, home to some of the most cutting edge scientific research in the entire galaxy.|[[Deel Draav]]|<ref name="SWG:CCFTLM" />}}
Kor Vella was located atop the [[Kor Vella mesa]], on the planet Corellia. Despite its transformation into a thriving economic hub, the city had maintained much of its rustic charm. Many of the settlement's original buildings still stood and the residents maintained historic areas throughout the city. Kor Vella also lacked the huge skyscrapers that dominated the skylines of most other Corellian cities.<ref name="SWG:KV" /> The city was known for its excellent scientific research.<ref name="SWG:CCFTLM" />

==History==
{{Quote|Someone is smuggling a spice known as ryll into Kor Vella. Ryll is a highly addictive spice. We need to find the source of the spice and break up their smuggling operation.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Lon Cope|Cope]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:CCFRSM" />}}
In Corellia's more primitive times, long before the advent of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] travel, intrepid explorers made their reputation by successfully scaling the Kor Vella mesa. The terrain was treacherous, and the area around the mesa boasted numerous predatory creatures. Those [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] who did manage to reach the mesa, however, found that the bleak, weather-beaten landscape actually offered great solitude. Kor Vella mesa became a site for introspection and meditation, where Corellians could escape the trials of daily life for a few hours of reflection.<ref name="SWG:KV" />

[[File:KorVella.png|thumb|left|250px|Kor Vella during the time of the Galactic Civil War]]
Nearly ten thousand years before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a small religious sect established a monastery on Kor Vella mesa. The religious retreat shunned metropolitan values and emphasized self-reliance over creature comforts. Despite Kor Vella's harsh rules, the religious retreat attracted other Corellians, who built shanties around the central monastery.<ref name="SWG:KV" />

Kor Vella's history changed dramatically when local miners located large deposits of [[Ore/Legends|ore]] near the mesa. This discovery coincided with a sudden surge in demand for Corellian [[Starship/Legends|starships]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. As starship manufacturers purchased ore from Kor Vella, the influx of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] nearly overwhelmed the community. Nearly overnight, the inhabitants of Kor Vella could afford all the luxuries that they had formerly despised. Kor Vella eventually dropped all pretense of being a religious retreat and emerged from relative isolation to become one of Corellia's most respected cities.<ref name="SWG:KV" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Kor Vella was garrisoned by a large [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] force that patrolled the city in an effort to crack down [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] insurgents.<ref name="SWG:P6" /><ref name="Crackdown" /> [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Zhanks]] and [[TA-667]] were garrisoned there.<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the criminal organization known as the [[Chirq Council]] established an important [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] operation in Kor Vella.<ref name="SWG:CCFRSM" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the mayor of Kor Vella [[Deel Draav]] was assassinated by the Chirq Council.<ref name="SWG:CCFTUM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|CorSec Case Files: The Unlucky Mayor|Corellia}}</ref>

==Inhabitants==
The following individuals were residents or visitors of the city in the time after the Battle of Yavin: [[Chertyl Ruluwoor (Human)|Chertyl Ruluwoor]], [[Denell Kel'Vannon]], [[Gilker Budz]], [[Lasha Bindari]], [[Skinkner]], [[Crowley (Twi'lek)|Crowley]],<ref name="SWG" /> Deel Draav, [[Hershel Sheridan]], [[Lon Cope]], [[Menchi Lerann]], and [[Jaylon Geissler]].<ref name="SWG:SK">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Kor Vella appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online role-playing game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
